description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'ProductReviewController' responsible for handling administrative web requests related to product reviews in an e-commerce application. The class includes methods for displaying product reviews, paging through review data, and removing reviews, with proper access controls and interaction with service layer components.

classes.name: ProductReviewController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller class managing admin endpoints for product reviews, including listing reviews with paging, viewing reviews for a product, and deleting reviews. It uses dependency injection for service components and applies security annotations.

methods.name: displayProductReviews
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the review page for a specific product, validating product ownership and redirecting if invalid.

methods.name: pageProductReviews
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch paginated reviews for a product, returning JSON with review details.

methods.name: deleteProductReview
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specific review, checking authorization before removal.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Configures the right menu context for the admin pages.
